tasks.description: Create migration 000070 to add execution_mode column (int, default 0) to listing_task. This makes DryRun a persisted DB field instead of the current gorm:'-' ephemeral flag. Drop the ephemeral interpretation path in a later step.

Update ListingTask model: remove DryRun bool gorm:"-", add ExecutionMode int with gorm column and json tags. Update CreateTaskInput: add ExecutionMode *int. Update UpdateTaskInput: add ExecutionMode *int. Define execution mode constants (ModeDryRun=0, ModeSandbox=1, ModeApprovalRequired=2, ModeProduction=3) in listingtask package.

Update Service.Create to persist execution_mode from input (default 0=ModeDryRun if nil). Update validateExecutePreconditions: remove the DecisionSnapshot JSON parsing hack that sets task.DryRun=true, read task.ExecutionMode from persisted column. In ExecuteTask: skip Prism and publish logic when mode is ModeDryRun or ModeSandbox, run Prism only for ModeSandbox and ModeProduction. Production path unchanged.

Change PublishHook type from func(taskID int64) error to func(taskID int64, mode ExecutionMode) error. Update the publishHook closure in router.go: load task execution_mode before deciding whether to publish. Update all test helpers constructing PublishHook to match new signature.

Update Execute handler to accept optional execution_mode query param or JSON body override. Admin can force a production task to run as dry-run. Add RBAC check: overriding mode requires listing_task:override_mode permission.

Create migration 000071 to: (1) add trace_id varchar(64) to listing_recommendation, (2) add trace_id varchar(64) to listing_task, (3) add index on listing_recommendation(trace_id). No new table needed: evidence is recorded as structured operation_log entries keyed by trace_id.
tests: migration runs on empty DB without error

tasks.description: Add TraceID string field to ListingRecommendation. Add TraceID string field to ListingTask. Generate UUID via google/uuid at start of Evaluate() and flow through each evaluation stage.

In loop.Service.Evaluate(): (1) generate UUID trace_id at start, (2) after completeness check, store operation_log evidence entry with module=evidence action=completeness_check and trace_id, (3) after profit calculation, log with trace_id, (4) store trace_id on ListingRecommendation record, (5) when creating listing task, set its trace_id too. Evidence reconstructed by querying operation_log WHERE ResourceID LIKE 'trace:TRACE_ID:%'.

In listingtask.Service.ExecuteTask(): after successful execution + publish, record operation_log evidence entry with module=evidence action=execution_result using task's trace_id. If task has no trace_id (legacy), skip silently.

Add GET /loop/evidence/:productId endpoint. Queries operation_log for all evidence entries related to the product_id. Returns structured timeline: completeness check, profit calc, recommendation, approval, execution result with source_type, source_id, summary, timestamp per entry.

Add POST /loop/evaluate/batch endpoint accepting JSON body with product_ids array and optional triggered_by. Service calls Evaluate() for each product ID sequentially. Returns BatchEvaluateResponse with per-product results and error info.

Refactor owner.Suggestions() from func(limit int) to func(filter SuggestionFilter) where filter includes: limit, decision, feedback_status, risk_level, sort_by (default=id), sort_order (default=desc). Update handler to parse query params. Service builds dynamic GORM query from filters.

Create migration 000072 to add evaluation_state varchar(32) default 'pending' to candidate_product. Valid states: pending, ready_for_evaluation, evaluating, evaluated, rejected. Distinct from status (overall lifecycle) and completeness_status (data completeness).
Add EvaluationState string field and state constants to candidate package. Update ListCandidateFilter with EvaluationState. Add to CreateCandidateInput and UpdateCandidateInput.

Add UpdateEvaluationState(productID, state) to candidate.Service. In loop.Service.Evaluate(): set candidate to evaluating before, evaluated after success, pending after failure. A candidate with completeness=complete can be set to ready_for_evaluation by UI or upstream workflow agent.

Add PATCH /candidates/:id/evaluation-state endpoint. Allows frontend or workflow agent to set evaluation state (e.g., mark candidate as ready_for_evaluation after data fill completes, or reset to pending for re-evaluation).

Create migration 000073 to add: (1) idempotency_key varchar(128) default '' to listing_task, (2) external_reference_id varchar(256) default '' to listing_task, (3) listing_task_ids bigint[] default '{}' to product_listing. Unique partial index on listing_task(idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key != ''.

Update ListingTask: add IdempotencyKey, ExternalReferenceID. Update CreateTaskInput and UpdateTaskInput. Update ProductListing: add ListingTaskIDs ([]int64, stored as postgres bigint array). Wire idempotency_key auto-generation in Create.

Update ExecuteTask: after publishHook succeeds, store external_reference_id returned by platform adapter. Update publishHook signature to return (string, error) or use a side-channel. Update publishHook closure in router.go to return platform product ID. Update ProductListing platform_product_id and listing_task_ids after execution.
